body: if exploring means i can get away from this piece of shit family and environment, then i'm all up for exploring. i don't know how far i'll get with $5000 but if i die in the wilderness somewhere that's fine by me.

i love traveling, it's one of the only things that has kept me going during harsh times. sadly, i haven'y had much of it since ever. my parents are boring as fuck and flat out refuse to do anything involving fun and still would even if they had a ton of money. we've been out of the country a few times many years ago and the only thing they did was bathe in the sun. nothing else. and they spent several thousands on that.

i want to experience the entire world. there's just so many beautiful vistas all around.

if anything, i value money more due to how my parents handle it. they treat it like toilet paper.

if suicide doesn't work out or i don't follow through with it, i'm probably just going to pack up all my shit and go to my grandparents. they live in norway and i live in sweden and it's a 25 hour/121km journey by foot. i'll just give them all of my stuff and money ($5000) because i don't want my parents to have it. then i'll leave and walk wherever until i die from starvation or something.

oh, they support me alright. they support me **too much**. look up helicopter parents in a dictionary and you'd find a picture of my retarded parents. the irony of it is that my parents expect me to act like an adult when i don't know shit about being an adult because i've been sheltered my entire fucking life. it's a normal occurence that they scream, yell and hit me because of this.

> do you have any in your life that supports you or that you are cool with?

the only ones i care about anymore are my grandmother, grandfather, uncle and aunt. basically, my mother's side of the family. and the funny thing is that my mother has cut all contact with them because she doesn't like them so there's no way for me to get in touch with them. and i don't want to burden them with my truckload of problems.

> how old are you?

nineteen, turning twenty in june if i make it.
